label: Small Biotech IND — FDA 1571 Narrative
description: FDA Form 1571 narrative for NovaTide-1 Phase 1 IND (DLBCL, bispecific antibody).

inputs.sponsor_address: 450 Innovation Drive, Suite 300, South San Francisco, CA 94080
inputs.study_design: an open-label, multicenter, dose-escalation study using a 3+3 design followed by dose-expansion cohorts
inputs.exploratory_endpoint: Minimal residual disease (MRD) negativity by flow cytometry
inputs.nonclinical_summary: NovaTide-1 demonstrated potent anti-tumor activity in NOD/SCID xenograft models bearing DLBCL tumors. Dose-dependent B-cell depletion and T-cell activation were observed. No unexpected toxicities were identified.
inputs.tox_finding_1: Transient cytokine release at highest dose (10 mg/kg); no mortality
inputs.tox_finding_2: Expected B-cell depletion; NOAEL = 3 mg/kg (HED ≈ 1 mg/kg)
inputs.gentox_finding: Negative in both assays (not applicable for biologic; performed for completeness)
inputs.previous_human_experience: No prior human exposure to NovaTide-1. The CD3×CD20 mechanism class has clinical precedent with mosunetuzumab (Lunsumio®) and glofitamab (Columvi®), supporting the feasibility and manageable safety profile of this approach.
inputs.pi_qualifications: Board-certified hematologist-oncologist; 15+ years lymphoma clinical trial experience; PI on 8 prior bispecific antibody studies
inputs.si_qualifications: Hematology/oncology fellowship-trained; 5 years phase 1 trial experience
